title: REVERSE: a chance a trig plays backwards
description: A master page (FUNC + LFO) where knobs A-H set, for tracks 1-8, the chance that a trig plays its sample backwards (a PLAY lock, flipped from the sound's). The page flashes an arrow as a track plays one backwards. Saved. Needs seq-events. 0.3: fixed: trigs really play backwards (0.2 switched forward to forward loop instead).
